posts.cooked:
My doubt is: I assume that there is an error in the answer key of Quiz 1(Intro to Python). In the below attached question(Q28), the question reads, “Which of the following changes would also include SQL in the final result?”, but the answer given is

  1. "Make the length condition len(item)%2==1 instead of ==0 "(which must be wrong as the elements AI and ML will not be printed, and that violates the question as it mentions SQL also must be included from the previous question(Q27) without any change in the initial output)
  2. “Remove the condition len(item)%2==0” which is perfectly correct.

28Q1190×884 101 KB

I gave my feedback regarding this, if you find this reasonable too please consider to share your opinion and feedbacks, and please share your thoughts if you consider the given answer to be right.

posts.name: Mantasha fatma
posts.cooked:
i have also doubt in this Q, only option2 should be correct.
In this question, the first option should be incorrect. Option 1 clearly states that replace len(item)%2==0 len(item)%2==1. if we do this, then ‘AI’ and ‘ML’ will be removed.

Since the question specifically states “also include SQL”, the expected interpretation is to include 'sql' in addition to the existing valid outputs, not by replacing them.

Then how option 1 is correct
